summary: Generation Income Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of a net lease property at 991 Nut Tree Road, Vacaville, CA via a wholly owned subsidiary. The property was sold to Taricens Medical Estates LLC for $2,475,000, yielding net proceeds of ~$2.356 million after expenses. The sale was completed on July 15, 2026, under a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated April 29, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a small asset disposition; watch for potential redeployment of proceeds.
